04 / A LITTLE CLARITY

Before you
start watching.

Episode names, numbering and subtitle availability, explained simply.

Is Episode 87 the same as Season 4 Episode 4?+

Yes. Season 4 starts at overall Turkish Episode 84. Episode 87 is the fourth episode of this season. Each guide displays both numbers so you can match the correct version.

Are Urdu subtitles and Urdu dubbing the same?+

No. Urdu subtitles are translated text accompanying Turkish audio. Urdu dubbing replaces the spoken audio. Dubbed editions may also use different episode cuts and numbering.

When are the English and Urdu subtitles released?+

Urdu and English editions of Episodes 84–87 have been verified by the publisher. Providers publish independently, so the Turkish broadcast time and subtitle upload time can differ.

Why does the drama have different names?+

The official Turkish title is Mehmed: Fetihler Sultanı. Viewers also search for Sultan Muhammad Fateh, Sultan Mehmed Fateh and Sultan Fatih. Fatih Al Sultani often refers to an Urdu-dubbed edition.

Does Episode Journal stream the episodes?+

Episode Journal provides release information and viewing guides. Full episodes are watched through external providers. An official TRT link identifies the Turkish original; subtitle availability must be checked separately.
